claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.124 UX audit exported and locally regraded at 100/100 with zero P findings, complete enrichment, export verification, and Texture 95.
The strict-clean caveat was duplicate trusted Crossref rows for the same Margret Plank prototyping work.
Source-finder topic selection deduplicates same-work candidates before applying the trusted-source cap.
Package source-ledger merging uses title/author/evidence fingerprints alongside DOI and URL identity while preserving concept links.
A package-export regression proves manifest, source report, and CourseIR bridge counts use distinct trusted works for the v0.15.124 duplicate-prototyping shape.

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.125 ZIP/log audit must prove duplicate source-finder DOI variants no longer inflate trusted source coverage in real provider output.
Fresh deployed output must prove Texture reaches 100/100 or identify the next concrete repeated shingle.
Every exported surface must agree: UI, ZIP, manifest, quality report, source report, digest logs, DOCX/PPTX files, and local regrade.
